svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from 8 mm steel plate: a collar 37.5 mm square with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongue 25 mm wide running out to 75 mm from the collar's centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the 25 mm square hole in the collar: drill 20 mm, file square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to a sliding fit on the torque tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and tap M5 through the collar side opposite the tongue

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On one face of the tongue, 30 mm from the centre: a 6 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm deep for the homing magnet (glue it in).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the tongue corners 2 mm and break all edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides onto the left end of the torque tube, magnet toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the arm, mid-plane 11 mm from the tube end; set screw into the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spot on the tube, medium threadlocker.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When stowed, the tongue rests on the stop pad and the latch pawl

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tongue is square to the tube and does not rock.
